145/** @internal Export an embedded shader as standard GLSL, with version and declaration macros.
146 * This function supplies the version directive. Guard the body's C++ include
147 * with #ifdef __cplusplus. The exported source contains the selected version
148 * and expanded declarations.
149 */
150inline std::string glsl_source(const std::string& source, profile p) { // Add the selected GLSL version and shared-declaration definitions.
151    std::istringstream lines(source); // Read the embedded shader one line at a time.
152    std::string line; // Read each embedded source line while checking version directives.
153    while (std::getline(lines, line)) { // Inspect each source line for an unsupported version directive.
154        std::size_t start = line.find_first_not_of(" \t\r"); // Set the beginning of the current token or range.
155        if (start != std::string::npos && line[start] == '#') { // Choose this branch when start differs from std::string::npos and line[start] equals '#'.
156            start = line.find_first_not_of(" \t", start + 1); // Set the beginning of the current token or range.
157            if (start != std::string::npos && line.compare(start, 7, "version") == 0) // Choose this branch when start differs from std::string::npos and line.compare(start, 7, "version") equals 0.
158                throw error("shared shaders must omit #version; glsl_source supplies it"); // Report shared shaders must omit #version. glsl_source supplies it.
159        } // End this scope in glsl source.
160    } // End this scope in glsl source.
161    const char* version = p == profile::es31   ? "310 es" // Set the current GL version text.
162                          : p == profile::es32 ? "320 es" // Select the version associated with this shader profile.
163                          : p == profile::gl43 ? "430 core" // Select the version associated with this shader profile.
164                          : p == profile::gl45 ? "450 core" // Select the version associated with this shader profile.
165                                               : "460 core"; // Select desktop GLSL 4.60 for the remaining profile.
166    std::string out = std::string("#version ") + version + "\n"; // Set the assembled shader text.
167    if (p == profile::es31 || p == profile::es32) // Choose this branch when p equals profile::es31 or p equals profile::es32.
168        out += "precision highp float;\nprecision highp int;\n"; // Set the assembled shader text.
169    out += // Set the assembled shader text.
170        "#define SHDR_BEGIN(name,x,y,z) layout(local_size_x=x,local_size_y=y,local_size_z=z) in;\n" // Emit a native workgroup declaration for this shader.
171        "#define SHDR_END()\n" // Remove the host-only shader wrapper terminator.
172        "#define SHDR_MAIN() void main()\n" // Map the shared entry-point spelling to native GLSL main.
173        "#define SHDR_UNIFORM(t,n) uniform t n;\n" // Emit a native typed uniform declaration.
174        "#define SHDR_SWIZZLE(v,s) (v).s\n" // Map shared swizzle syntax to native GLSL component selection.
175        "#define SHDR_NOT(v) not(v)\n" // Map shared boolean negation to the native GLSL builtin.
176        "#define SHDR_IN(t,n) in t n\n" // Emit a native input parameter qualifier.
177        "#define SHDR_OUT(t,n) out t n\n" // Emit a native output parameter qualifier.
178        "#define SHDR_INOUT(t,n) inout t n\n" // Emit a native input-output parameter qualifier.
179        "#line 1\n"; // Restore shader line numbering before appending the original source.
180 // Desktop GLSL accepts highp precision qualifiers from GLSL 4.10 onward.
181    return out + detail::expand_declarations(source, p == profile::es31 || p == profile::es32); // Add the selected GLSL version and shared-declaration definitions.
182} // End this scope in glsl source.

1725inline std::map<std::string, std::vector<kernel_factory>>& shader_registry() { // Share the compiled shader factories discovered during startup.

1739    } // End this scope in runtime.
1740    ~shader_registration() { // Unregister this factory before its dynamic module is unloaded.

1742        const std::vector<kernel_factory>::iterator it = // Find this module's factory among the registrations.
1743            std::find(entries.begin(), entries.end(), factory_); // Keep the compiled shader construction callback.
1744        if (it != entries.end()) // Choose this branch when it differs from entries.end().
1745            entries.erase(it); // Remove this module's registration and preserve the other factories.
1746        if (entries.empty()) // Choose this branch when entries.empty().
1747            shader_registry().erase(name_); // Share the compiled shader factories discovered during startup.
1748    } // End this scope in runtime.
